title: 第19章 龙魂岛的规矩九皇传人第20章 鬼背书生疯狂杀戮
slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
半天后，冥界无尽黑海，数百艘楼船在黑海之上悠悠的前行。
并开始缓缓的向着一座巨大无比的黑色岛屿汇聚。
随后纷纷停在了岛屿的港口。
在楼船停下后，数十个身穿黑色作战服的壮汉，来到了赢天等人所汇聚的船舱内。
这群人中为首之人看着赢天等人，语气冰冷的说道：“现在已经到龙魂岛的外围港口了。”
“我来跟你们说一些，在龙魂岛的注意事项和规矩。”
“一，龙魂岛内有特殊规则，所以无法召唤守护灵。”
“想要依靠守护灵，争王争霸，在这里行不通！”
“在这里你唯一能依靠的只有自己的实力！”
“二，龙魂岛奉行，强者为尊，弱者为食，不会禁止你们互相厮杀争斗，实力就是这里的规矩！”
“但，不允许在公共场所和某些地方私斗，比如课堂，修炼室，训练室。”
“食堂，澡堂，厕所，宿舍等等都不允许乱斗。”
“同时两派之间的战斗，可以邀请其他势力加入。“
”但其他人有权拒绝，不允许强行牵扯到其他人，以免造成，龙魂岛的混乱。”
“一经发现格杀勿论！”
“三，龙魂岛内充满了数量众多的恶灵，这些恶灵最低的实力都在众合，甚至有大焦热境界的存在。“
”所以没事最好别到处乱跑，否则出了事，龙魂岛概不负责，更不会出现救援。”
“四，龙魂岛分为四个区域，从高到低分为天，地，玄，黄。”
“等级越高的区域资源也就越丰富，这些资源包括冥气浓度。“
”食物，药品，修炼资源，导师指导，居住环境。”

“人灵技秘技，唤灵呼吸法等等一切最好的待遇。”
“只要你足够强，龙魂岛上你做主！”
“五，龙魂岛每一个月，会进行一次大比，排名前十者奖励十分丰厚！”
“同时岛内还有三大榜单，分为天骄榜，势力榜，排行榜。”
“每一个上榜之人，都能得到丰厚的奖励，尤其是最后的排行榜，待遇更是高的吓人。”
“同时击杀恶灵和登上榜单都能得到丰富的积分，积分可在龙魂岛内兑换一切资源。”
“六，龙魂岛内的重力，是其他地方的十倍，进入的区域越深，重力也就越高。”
“最深处达到了百倍以上，那里是只有怪物才能生存的地方，也是整个龙魂岛的核心处。”
“因为里面都是一群真正的怪物，所以核心处，又被称作，怪物聚集地！”
“善意提醒，没有做好准备，适应不了的，别往深处去，尤其是那怪物聚集地。”
“好了，该说的我已经说了，现在下船，准备登岛！”
说完转身便带着身后的壮汉们离开了船楼。
赢天听闻壮汉的介绍后，再看这壮汉的身体，不由抽了抽嘴。
难怪这些家伙每一个都长得十分壮实，那肌肉都快要爆出来了。
原来是在最低十倍重力的环境下一直生活，这要是不壮才有鬼啊。
看来还得想办法控制身材呀，长壮点倒是没什么，可要是太壮了，那就影响审美了。
想完，赢天便带着赢家与白家的族人们向着船舱外走去。
船舱内的其他人见状也纷纷走了出去。
很快来到港口内的赢天，便感受到了一股力量压在身上，由外而内的分散在全身。
content_en:
Half a day later, there was an endless black sea in the underworld, and hundreds of ships were moving leisurely on the black sea.
And began to slowly converge towards a huge black island.
Then they all stopped at the island's port.
After the building ship stopped, dozens of strong men in black combat uniforms came to the cabin where Yingtian and others gathered.
The leader of the group looked at Yingtian and others and said in a cold tone: "We have now arrived at the outer port of Dragon Soul Island."
"Let me tell you some precautions and rules on Dragon Soul Island."
"First, there are special rules in Dragon Soul Island, so guardian spirits cannot be summoned."
"If you want to rely on guardian spirits to fight for kingship and hegemony, it won't work here!"
"The only thing you can rely on here is your own strength!"
"Two, Dragon Soul Island adheres to the principle that the strong are respected and the weak are eaten. We will not prohibit you from fighting with each other. Strength is the rule here!"
"However, private fighting is not allowed in public places and certain places, such as classrooms, practice rooms, and training rooms."
"No fighting is allowed in the cafeteria, bathhouse, toilets, dormitories, etc."
"At the same time, the battle between the two factions can invite other forces to join."
"But others have the right to refuse, and are not allowed to involve others forcibly, so as not to cause chaos on Dragon Soul Island."
"If discovered, shoot to death!"
"Third, Dragon Soul Island is filled with a large number of evil spirits. The lowest strength of these evil spirits is in Zhonghe, and there are even those in the Great Jiaore Realm."
"So it's best not to run around if nothing happens. Otherwise, Dragon Soul Island will not be responsible if something happens, and there will be no rescue."
"Four, Dragon Soul Island is divided into four areas. From high to low, it is divided into heaven, earth, Xuan and Huang."
"The higher the level, the richer the resources in the area, including the concentration of underworld energy."
"Food, medicine, cultivation resources, mentor guidance, and living environment."
"The secret skills of human spirit, the spirit summoning breathing method and all the best treatment."
"As long as you are strong enough, you make the decision on Dragon Soul Island!"
"Five, Dragon Soul Island will hold a competition every month, and the top ten will be rewarded very generously!"
"At the same time, there are three major lists on the island, which are divided into the Genius List, the Power List, and the Ranking List."
"Everyone who is on the list will receive generous rewards, especially for those on the final list, the treatment is even more frightening."
"You can get rich points by killing evil spirits and climbing the list at the same time. The points can be exchanged for all resources in Dragon Soul Island."
"Sixth, the gravity in Dragon Soul Island is ten times that of other places. The deeper the area you enter, the higher the gravity."
"The deepest point reaches more than a hundred times. It is a place where only monsters can survive. It is also the core of the entire Dragon Soul Island."
"Because there are a group of real monsters inside, the core is also called the monster gathering place!"
"A kind reminder, if you are not prepared and can't adapt, don't go into the depths, especially where monsters gather."
"Okay, I've said what I need to say, now get off the boat and get ready to land on the island!"
After saying that, he turned around and left the ship building with the strong men behind him.
After hearing the strong man's introduction, Yingtian couldn't help but twitch when he looked at the strong man's body.
No wonder each of these guys are very strong, and their muscles are about to burst out.
It turns out that he has been living in an environment with a minimum of ten times the gravity. This is a ghost if he is not strong.
It seems that you have to find a way to control your figure. It's fine to be stronger, but if you are too strong, it will affect your aesthetics.
After thinking about it, Ying Tian led Ying Tian and the Bai family members towards the outside of the cabin.
Seeing this, other people in the cabin also walked out.
Yingtian soon arrived at the port and felt a force pressing on him, spreading throughout his body from the outside in.
